evals.name: Typed Environment Separation & Relative Proxy Path
evals.prompt: Configure Angular environment separation for development and production, ensuring dev uses relative /api path and production uses fully qualified gateway URL.
evals.expected_output: Creates typed environment.ts with relative apiUrl '/api' and environment.prod.ts with production URL, without hardcoding URLs in services.
assertions: Configures typed EnvironmentConfig interface with production, apiUrl, and wsUrl
Sets development apiUrl to relative path '/api' to leverage reverse proxy
Sets production apiUrl to fully qualified HTTPS gateway
Imports environment symbol from base environment module without hardcoding URLs

evals.name: Development & Staging Reverse Proxy Setup
evals.prompt: Create reverse proxy configurations proxy.dev.json and proxy.staging.json to forward /api and WebSocket traffic and bypass CORS.
evals.expected_output: Generates proxy.dev.json and proxy.staging.json with target, changeOrigin true, secure flag, pathRewrite, and WebSocket ws true.
assertions: Configures proxy.dev.json with changeOrigin set to true
Configures secure flag as false for dev and true for staging
Configures pathRewrite mapping ^/api to target backend versioned path
Includes WebSocket proxying flag ws true for real-time endpoints

evals.name: Automated Environment & Hardcoded URL Audit
evals.prompt: Audit an Angular codebase using audit_angular_environment.py to detect hardcoded localhost URLs and verify proxy configurations.
evals.expected_output: Executes scripts/audit_angular_environment.py against the workspace, reporting presence of environment files, proxy configurations, and hardcoded URL violations.
assertions: Detects raw hardcoded localhost and IP addresses in source files
Verifies presence of environment.ts and environment.prod.ts
Outputs structured compliance score and checkpoint results
